facts.fact: The GIZ and Ministry of Health landscape assessment states that DHIS 2 was deployed in 96% of the 246 health facilities it surveyed across the 16 districts, 202 of them primary (CHC, CHP, MCHP), 34 secondary and 10 tertiary; the sample favoured hospitals and high-output PHUs, the report gives no numerator or split by facility type, and it counts deployment, not facilities entering their own reports. The survey is undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment states that all 34 secondary and all 10 tertiary facilities surveyed had M&E Officers whose role was predominantly data capture and upload on DHIS 2; the survey is undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment states that DHIS 2 was deployed in 96% of the 246 facilities surveyed, of which 202 were primary: Community Health Centres, Community Health Posts and Maternal and Child Health Posts; it does not break the 96% down by facility type or say who keys the primary facilities' data. The survey is undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment states that in all secondary and tertiary facilities surveyed, 44 hospitals, M&E Officers capture data and upload it on DHIS 2 at the facility; it says nothing of entry at primary facilities. The survey is undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment states that M&E Officers at District Health Management Team level have a similar role to those in hospitals, predominantly data capture and upload on DHIS 2; the survey is undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment lists DHIS2 as the Health Management Information System deployed by the MoHS, and states that the MoHS hosts the DHIS 2 platform virtually; undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.

The assessment states that 83% of funding for the digital health tools deployed in the facilities surveyed was donor-driven and 17% private, with no significant public contribution, and that the MoHS's 2022 statutory budget made no provision for digital health; the figures cover all 16 tools found, DHIS2 among them, and not DHIS2 alone.

The assessment's table of tools found in the facilities surveyed names a partner or company as the organisation deploying each of the four EMRs: CUAMM (Elysium EMR), Partners In Health (OpenMRS), GOPA-GIZ (FMIS) and Sierra Rutile (Sierra Rutile EMR); it adds that tools other than DHIS 2 were deployed in only 4% of the facilities. Undated, so the report's date of January 2023 is used.
